qt: to the Commission Georgios Aftias (PPE) Subject:

According to the second European Annual Asylum and Migration Report, published on 6 November 2026, Greece continues to come under migratory pressure and is eligible to receive support from the Annual Solidarity Pool for 2027. The fact that the country is situated along the external borders of the EU means that it requires extra support for reception, examination of asylum applications, border management and returns, as well as a burden on island and border regions. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.

What financial support does it propose for Greece in 2027 through the Solidarity Pool and other European financial instruments, what allocation criteria will apply and what is the timeline for finalising and disbursing the funding?

What additional financial support will it make available to Greece to speed up the legal return of those who are not entitled to international protection and to allow the effective implementation of readmission obligations applicable to third countries, while respecting fundamental rights?
